item.title: Supreme Court to weigh bans on AR-15s in major Second Amendment case
item.description: This case tests how far the Supreme Court's recent expansion of Second Amendment rights — from Heller's 2008 recognition of an individual right to bear arms to Bruen's 2022 historical-tradition test — extends to semi-automatic rifles like the AR-15. item.title: U.S. loses measles elimination status; Virginia reports uptick
